name: Team activity
description: Who is doing what, and when it gets done.
long_description:
A read-only pulse of the initiative's people. How the work spreads across the team, the daily rhythm of what gets finished, and how the open pile leans by priority — with the finished total as the headline.

Nothing here needs setting up — every widget reads the initiative the dashboard lives on.
release_notes: Adds a board dealing every open task into a column per person, and what is still open beside what is finished.

binding.sql: SELECT count(*) AS finished FROM tasks WHERE completed_at IS NOT NULL
SELECT count(*) AS open FROM tasks WHERE completed_at IS NULL
SELECT date_trunc('day', completed_at) AS day, count(*) AS finished FROM tasks WHERE completed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY date_trunc('day', completed_at) ORDER BY date_trunc('day', completed_at)
SELECT assignee.display_name AS person, count(*) AS open FROM tasks WHERE completed_at IS NULL GROUP BY assignee.display_name ORDER BY count(*) DESC
SELECT priority, count(*) AS tasks FROM tasks WHERE completed_at IS NULL GROUP BY priority
SELECT concat(project.name, ' · ', title) AS card, assignee.display_name AS person, due_date FROM tasks WHERE completed_at IS NULL ORDER BY project.name, due_date
